title: Logic Against Bias: Textual Entailment Mitigates Stereotypical Sentence Reasoning
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured the presence of stereotypical reasoning in religious contexts using the StereoSet dataset. This involved a model scoring and selecting between stereotypical, anti-stereotypical, and unrelated sentences when presented with a religious context.
findings: Textual entailment models consistently outperform similarity-based pretrained models (like standard BERT, RoBERTa, and SimCSE) in mitigating stereotypical bias related to religion. The entailment models achieved higher and more stable iCAT scores on the religion sub-tasks of the StereoSet benchmark, indicating they are both fairer and better at the language understanding task.
